name: Voice Changer
summary: Sound like another person on any call or meeting app. The desktop offers your changed voice as a "ForkMesh Voice" microphone; the web page lets you try voices, hear yourself and record clips. Audio stays on your device.

screenshots.alt: The desktop Voice Changer page running the Deep baritone voice, with the ForkMesh Voice microphone picked in a call app's audio settings

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

config.title: Voice Changer
config.description: Try a different voice in your browser, hear yourself with headphones and record a clip. Audio is changed on your device.

permissions.label: Listen to the microphone you pick while the voice changer runs; the audio stays on this device
Keep your chosen voice and your usual pitch in this browser only
Create a "ForkMesh Voice" microphone while running (Linux), or play the changed voice into a virtual cable you chose
Run the system's audio helpers (pw-cat, pw-loopback, or parec, pacat and pactl) to move audio
Send a voice description you type to ForkMesh AI to design voice settings; recordings are never sent
